recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: robots learning to navigate unfamiliar floorplans room by room
a quiet use-after-free sleeping in an old secure kernel
invisible compounds still debated in the everyday food supply
july fog holding san francisco at thirteen degrees
summer daylight stretching past half past eight
yacht-rock daydreams drifting through overcast bay air

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Stutter-house beat fragments drop from the top; tap each slice on the downbeat to stitch a loop before the track glitches out.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each clean 8-bar loop unlocks a brighter synth layer and the crowd pulse syncs perfectly.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, off-beat ghost notes appear, and missed taps add crackling static to the mix.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform nightclub with Fred-again-style stutter visuals

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw a one-thumb path for a pocket robot through a foggy SF apartment; furniture slides between runs like a navigation model retraining.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Shortest clean route makes the destination bloom warm amber light through the fog.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Rooms multiply, doorways rotate mid-run, and phantom walls appear from stale map memory.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: blueprint wireframe on damp graph paper

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe drifting vinyl shards into matching groove lanes before overcast fog swallows the turntable — Fleetwood Mac side A vs side B.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Completing a side fills the screen with soft amber glow and a needle-drop sigh.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Shards spin faster, duplicate labels bait wrong lanes, fog creeps inward from the edges.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor album sleeves dissolving in bay fog

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick memory blocks into correct heap slots before a privilege-escalation timer hits zero — one-screen kernel triage.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Each clean allocation triggers a satisfying green terminal chime and shrinks the exploit window.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Ghost pointers multiply, gravity tilts the heap, and dangling references chase your last placement.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: green phosphor CRT terminal with scanlines and cursor blink
